title: The Dancing Bear
text: A showman with a whip and a great bear on a chain, dancing for nobody on an empty road. The bear's paws are bloody. It turns, and turns, and looks at you over the showman's shoulder as if it knows exactly what you are.

options.label: The strongest breaks the bear's chain, and gives it back its freedom.

outcomes.text: The bear walks off into the trees without looking back, and the showman runs the other way.
The bear remembers every whip it ever felt, and does not ask whose they were.

options.label: Buy the bear off him, and spare it the whip.

outcomes.text: It follows you a day, and fights for you like a wall, and then goes home.

options.label: Watch the dance, and pay the man. It is not your bear to free.

outcomes.text: It is a sad dance, and the bear's eyes never leave you, and you see them for nights after.
